ValidationRule.description: At least one Contact Role is required before moving Opportunity to Contract.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ContactRole__c = False, Probability >= 0.35, NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Churn Likely')), CloseDate >= DATE(2022,8,9), NOT(ISNEW()), NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one Contact Role is required before moving Opportunity to Analyze or Greater Probability.
